_rules: Additive only: preserve every existing entry, including all contextpatch entries.
Back up the live configuration before editing. Prefer the contextpatch CLI configure_claude_desktop command in dry-run mode first.
Replace REPLACE_ tokens with real values in the live file only.
AZURE_CONFIG_DIR is a filesystem path and is not a secret, so it may appear here.
Never place a client secret, certificate, certificate password, or token in this file.
Credentials are resolved by DefaultAzureCredential from the isolated Azure CLI profile, not from this file.
Pin an exact version. Do not use a floating tag and do not use npx to resolve at launch.
Enable only the namespace tokens captured from the pinned build. Do not enable mutation namespaces in this rollout.
